channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iranian fishermen struggle to survive amid Hormuz blockade
item.description: The livelihoods of Iranian fishermen have taken a hit amid the US blockade on Iran’s ports in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Tehran labels US attacks ‘gross violation’, says it is prepared to respond
item.description: The US says it struck boats and missile sites in Iran, shortly after both sides had indicated progress in peace talks.

item.title: Iran’s president praises military after US strikes
item.description: President Masoud Pezeshkian praised Iran’s military capabilities after the US carried out ‘self-defence’ strikes on Iran

item.title: India, US strike critical minerals deal: What’s in it, why does it matter?
item.description: Agreement is latest US has signed as it seeks to diversify its rare earths supply chain.

item.title: Israeli air attacks kill seven Palestinians in Gaza
item.description: At least five Palestinians killed in Israeli attack on a refugee camp in central Gaza, officials said.

item.title: Iran condemns US strikes as 'gross violation' of ceasefire
item.description: The attacks took place while Iranian and Qatari negotiators were in Doha for peace talks.

item.title: Four killed as school minibus collides with train in Belgium
item.description: Two schoolchildren, their chaperone and the minibus driver were killed in the crash, says a Belgian minister.

item.title: Eleven killed in Lebanon village as Israel intensifies strikes
item.description: Israel says it struck 100 Hezbollah infrastructure sites and fighters in Lebanon, after PM Benjamin Netanyahu vows to "crush" Hezbollah.

item.title: Netanyahu says Israel will intensify strikes against Hezbollah
item.description: The Israeli military hits targets in eastern Lebanon after the prime minister announces further strikes.

item.title: More than 1.5m foreign pilgrims begin Hajj despite Iran war fears
item.description: Saudi Arabia says that is 11,000 more than the number of Muslims who travelled to the Gulf kingdom last year.
